subject: Renewal roadmap workshop — prioritized timebands & attendee gating
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal roadmap workshop — initial availability and stakeholders

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the partnership — we want to lock in a 90-120 minute workshop to walk through the renewal roadmap, upcoming integration priorities, and a short technical deep-dive for our infra team. The session will include execs (CTO + Head of Product), platform engineering, and procurement observers.

Key asks:
- Can we get 2-3 suggested timebands (US-friendly) that let us sequence an exec-first slot and a later technical deep-dive?
- We need a brief attendee matrix so procurement can plan for SOW/DocuSign timing (attached).
- Please confirm if you can record and share slides.

Attached: attendee_matrix.xlsx (just a matrix of names/roles/timezones)

Would appreciate a proposal by Monday so we can land invites this week.

Best,
Priya
Director, Renewal Programs
BlueWave Health

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap workshop — initial availability and stakeholders

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear asks and the attendee matrix. I went through the list and to reduce scheduling friction I propose we run a sequenced workshop across two blocks: an "Exec roadmap" (45–60 min) followed by a "Technical deep-dive" (45–60 min) 90–120 minutes later. This keeps the execs' time capped while giving engineers a deeper session without duplicative attendance.

Proposed timeband options (US Pacific time):
A) Tue 21 Nov — Exec 10:00–10:45, Tech 12:00–13:00
B) Wed 22 Nov — Exec 09:00–09:45, Tech 11:00–12:00
C) Thu 23 Nov — Exec 14:00–14:45, Tech 16:00–17:00 (execs prefer afternoon)

Notes:
- We can handle recording and provide slides + short recording (hosted link).
- Suggest one Redwood backup host for the technical session in case of last-minute conflicts.
- Attached is a quick PDF with timebands and a proposed attendee gating (who needs to join which block).

Attached: proposed_timebands.pdf

If one of these works, I will: 1) lock calendar invites, 2) create a HubSpot meeting record, and 3) loop in Marissa on ops/runbook.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal roadmap workshop — initial availability and stakeholders

+1 on the sequenced approach. A couple of operational things from my side:
- I'll be the primary CS owner for the tech deep-dive; propose Alex as backup host for exec session.
- Recording permissions: we should ask BlueWave to confirm whether slides are shareable with engineering teams beyond the attendees (some content will reference roadmap items tied to pilot programs).
- I'll prepare a one-page runbook (attendee list, dial-in, recording link, slides owner) and share it in the invite.

On a practical note: if they pick timeband C, we need to reorder two internal office hours that day — I can cover those but would prefer B or A.

Marissa
